# architecture fixtures

- `basic.mmd`: mermaid-svg 0.7.0 sample (MIT), copied from
  `crates/nana-ui-runtime/tests/fixtures/mermaid/architecture.mmd`.
- `junctions.mmd`, `align-grid.mmd`: examples from the Mermaid architecture
  documentation (https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/architecture.html), MIT
  licensed, © Knut Sveidqvist and contributors.
- `groups-cjk.mmd`, `minimal.mmd`: written for this engine (nested groups,
  `{group}` edges, labels, both arrow ends, CJK titles, a custom icon name).
